items.title: Bobby Johnson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: I never really got a chance to play with them too much. I liked Don Redman’s band.

ctx.x: A lot of people didn’t know that. The morning that Benny left to go to Hollywood to do that movie — one of the big movies, I can’t think of the lady’s name — but anyway he got his break and he went and Miles was just a kid from East St. Louis. And he was downstairs waiting to see Benny then. Benny took him out west with him, and then I joined after that — I’m trying to think when I go back — then I joined Erskine Hawkins, that’s when, after that. I wasn’t too particular about joining Erskine Hawkins. I’ll tell…
Plus he was a — Don Redman was a great arranger too, right?
